name: labs/picoquant__lumipy
title: PicoQuant Luminosa through LumiPy Measurement
intro: PicoQuant Luminosa through LumiPy Measurement, adapted from picoquant/lumipy. It reads `version`, `analysis_names`, `running`, `elapsed_meas_time` and 16 more; sets `scan_range_left`, `scan_range_top`, `scan_range_width`, `scan_range_height` and 2 more; runs `configure_image_stop`, `configure_point_stop`, `set_ptu_output`, `start_measurement` and 7 more. `configure_image_stop`: configure the image stop conditions (frame count, photon threshold, time). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/picoquant__lumipy --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/picoquant__lumipy --backend fake --mcp
